VIX in backwardation = market pricing near-term stress higher than long-term. Classic pre-event setup (4 macro events in 30d). VIX9D > VIX1M > VIX3M > VIX6M = front-loaded fear. Typical resolution: vol crushes back to contango within 5-10 sessions after event-cluster passes. Buying long-dated calls or selling near-term puts captures the spread.

📌 Macro playbook for ROST: (1) Hold existing 3.6% position · macro context supports long-term thesis. (2) Don't add new exposure pre-FOMC/NFP (+22 to +24d). (3) Wait for post-NFP price action — if SPY/XRT find footing and macro vol calms, ROST re-rates higher. (4) If macro events trigger risk-off (VIX > 25, XRT < $66), the trade-down narrative actually accelerates and ROST becomes a buy on weakness. (5) Sector rotation is a temporary headwind; ROST as a defensive cyclical outperforms peer XRT in this regime.
✗ MACRO INVALIDATES: (a) Regime transitions to RISK_OFF_TRENDING (VIX > 22 sustained AND breadth < 50%) = reduce all longs 35% per playbook. (b) Regime transitions to PANIC (VIX > 35) = NO LONGS allowed. (c) CPI prints > 3.6% (hawkish surprise) → rate-cut expectations die → ROST PE compression. (d) Major tariff escalation on imports → ROST gross margin hit (~−200bps possible). (e) Recession indicators flash green AND ROST also weakens = trade-down narrative broken (rare but lethal to thesis).
